description: This file declares utility functions for string manipulation, including trimming, prefix and suffix checks, splitting, parsing integers and booleans, and pattern recognition within the 'header_checker' project's 'utils' namespace.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string view.

methods.name: StartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string view starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string view ends with a given suffix.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Splits a string view into substrings based on delimiter characters.

methods.name: ParseInt
methods.description: Attempts to parse an integer from a given string, returning an llvm::Optional<int>.

methods.name: ParseBool
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from a string, likely recognizing 'true'/'false'.

methods.name: IsGlobPattern
methods.description: Determines if a string view matches a glob pattern format.
